paper_title: Axion phenomenology and $θ$-dependence from $N_f = 2+1$ lattice QCD
coupling_convention: f_a in GeV vs m_a in eV
notes: This lattice QCD paper computes the topological susceptibility and its temperature dependence to predict the axion dark matter window. It reports a value of the axion decay constant fa = 1.0e12 GeV (for post-inflation PQ breaking) as an upper bound assuming axions make up all dark matter, but this is a single cosmological prediction rather than an exclusion curve in the fa-ma plane. There is no mass-dependent exclusion limit or coupling constraint plot; the main results are on the topological susceptibility. No proper (mass, coupling) data points can be extracted for a standard exclusion limit. The single fa value is a cosmological relic-abundance prediction, not an exclusion curve, so no data points are emitted.
